q: We want to say we cut emissions by 20 percent. What do we need to back it?
title: Backing a "we cut emissions by X%" claim
short: A base year and a current year calculated the same way, with the same boundary and factors, and a statement of whether the cut is absolute or per unit of output. If you sold a unit or changed method, recalculate the base year first. Keep the workings so anyone can repeat the 20 percent.

ul: Base year figure and current year figure, same scopes.
Same emission factors, or both years recalculated with new ones.
Absolute or intensity named, with the unit.
Main reasons for the change listed.
Comparing a year with Scope 3 to a year without.
A cut that comes only from lower production, reported as efficiency.
Netting carbon credits off the inventory.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.

sources.label: ISO 14021, Environmental labels and declarations: self-declared claims (iso.org)
